POC focused on function-calling for CI workflows + safe sandboxing. Key ask: let model agents trigger test runner + linters and report structured build logs without any access to internal prod secrets. Wants ability to pin model version per project and force fallback rules. Streaming token latency is a hard requirement for dev UX — devs expect sub-50ms token latency for completions and <200ms tail for interactive copilot sessions.

Recent convo highlights: – Eng lead: 'We need deterministic builds; if the agent runs tests it must run in an isolated container with strict network egress controls.' – Security: 'audit log retention + KMS-managed keys mandatory; cannot allow remote exec to touch our artifact store.'

Acceptance criteria: sandbox demonstrates no escape for 1000 fuzzed test runs; audit logs show per-invocation KMS usage; model pinning works and fallback to smaller quantized model if capacity exhausted.

Stubs/links: see Drive POC folder and security deck above. Jira INF-4421 covers sandbox instrumentation. Quick note: devs prefer short prompts + per-project model pin config in the console.

Short-hand / misc: cost-sensitive but willing to pay for guaranteed latency. Wants SSO + SCIM integration. Retention: 30d logs, longer for audit exports.
